page_title: TOR 1-1 MON | Torino v Monza 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Torino failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
87' It is time for a substitution. Gianluca Caprari (Monza) is on for Dany Mota.
83' Alieu Njie (Torino) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
82' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
80' The resulting corner from Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
79' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Che Adams (Torino) latches on to a pass inside the box, but his low effort towards the right post is well blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.
76' Armando Izzo (Monza) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
76' Alieu Njie (Torino) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
75' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

75' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Stefano Turati guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
72' Samuele Vignato (Monza) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
71' Substitution. Alieu Njie (Torino) in, Nikola Vlasic out.
71' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) replaces Valentino Lazaro.
70' Samuele Vignato (Monza) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic intercepts the ball.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Maldini leaves the pitch and Samuele Vignato (Monza) comes on.
66' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Milan Djuric (Monza) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
62' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
61' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Alessandro Bianco (Monza) is given a yellow card.
59' 1 - 0 Valentino Lazaro sends in a great cross from the corner, finding Adam Masina (Torino) who outjumps the defence to finish into the top right corner with a header. The score is 1:0.
59' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
59' Adam Masina (Torino) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

57' Daniel Maldini (Monza) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
50' Torino are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
48' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Rosario Abisso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' Che Adams (Torino) gets a yellow card.
44' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marcus Pedersen (Torino), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
44' Monza seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
42' Pedro Pereira (Monza) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
39' Pedro Pereira (Monza) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who smothers the ball.
36' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
33' Monza fail to score from a corner as Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) leaps to collect the ball.
32' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
30' Warren Bondo (Monza) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
29' Wonderful movement by Torino. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
27' Saul Coco (Torino) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.

25' What a save from Vanja Milinkovic-Savic! Milan Djuric (Monza) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
22' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
21' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
21' Che Adams (Torino) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
19' Warren Bondo (Monza) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

16' Warren Bondo (Monza) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

16' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Monza are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
16' Saul Coco (Torino) meets a cross and produces a header towards the middle of the net, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
15' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
13' The game is interrupted. Andrea Carboni (Monza) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
13' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
12' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Rosario Abisso interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Warren Bondo (Monza).
6' Monza are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
5' A neat pass is well received by Pedro Pereira (Monza), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
2' Daniel Maldini (Monza) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
1' The match has just started.
Monza will kick the game off.
Rosario Abisso will supervise the game today.
